snippet.title: Croakwood Release Window Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2026
snippet.description: Croakwood is a relaxed and creative town building simulation game about frogs, nature, and an ancient forest! Design and create a town from the ground up, explore an old and mysterious forest, guide the growth of a community of tiny amphibians, and meet interesting characters along the way. Look for it this winter! https://wholesomegames.com/ #summergamefest #wholesomedirect2026 #wholesomedirect
